For ſo imeſtimable benefites, I wil alwayes praiſe thee witb Pſalmes, Canticles, or other thankes in this life : and eternally in the life to come. Exhortation punishment. PSALME. LXI. Aiuſt man encoregeth his owne ſoule to ſerue God in ſincere humilitie, 9: exhorteth alſo al others to truſt in God, not in falſe and worldlie pollicie, or wealth, beeaaſe Gods powre and mercie wil renaer to euerie one they deſerue. Vnto the end, fora Iduthun a Pſalme of Dauid. Directed to Idithun, one of the maſters of muſike, to ſing it, or to make tune for it. I hal not my ſoule be ſubiect to God for of him is my ſal-2 Duation. The wicked threating to ruinate others, Dauid, or anie iuſt man, feareth them not, be- cauſe his ſoule is ſubiect to God. † For he is my God, and my ſauiour : my receiuer I shal be moued no more. Therfore Tfirmely purpoſe neuer to be moued from God. †A How long ſet you violently vpon a man: you al doe kil : as it were vpon a wal, that is leaning, and a wal shaken. d In vaine do you myn aduerſaries ſtil aſſault me, though ye be al confederate to ki I mes ſuppoſing me to be like a ruinous, or shaken wal, that is eaſily throwne downe. † But yet they thought to repel my price, I ranne in thirſt:5 they bleſſed with their mouth, and curſed with their hart. They thinck ſtil to depriue me of my reward, the price of my laboures and merites,h bue Irunne ſo much more diligently, as thirſting after righteouſnes in this life, and glorie in ther next, to finish my courſe. A moſt dangerous tentation, when after threates and crueltie, perſecutors endeuour by ſwete wordes, and promiſes to perſwaed the iuft to fal into ſinne. † But yet my ſoule be thou ſubiect to God : becauſe my pati- ence is from him. † Becauſe he is my God, and my, ſauiour : my helper I shal not remoue. I reſolutly purpoſe not to yeld to anie tentations. † In God is my ſaluation, and my glorie : the God of my helpe, and my hope is in God. † Hope in him al ye the congregation of people: powre out your harts before him, God is our helper for euer. Gods faithful ſeruantes are not only conſtant themſelues, but alſo exhorte ard perſwade al others, as much as in them lieth, toſerue God and truſt in him.
